item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossless)】WAV - Nothing on (But the Radio) [AI Super Resolution Upscale from FlashSR - OG file: NOTHING ON BUT THE RADIO - FREY. MIX.wav ]
item.description:
I found a file in Seeker a couple of months ago while searching for Lady Gaga's unreleased stuff and I came across a seemingly lossless file of Nothing On (But the Radio), the second mix, fan extended. It was labelled as "FREY. MIX" but I don't have any idea of who they might be. I checked the OG file spectrum and there were cuts below 20kHz, and I managed to try and get an upscale of the song with FlashSR in MVSEP. It sounds better than it used to sound, but lemme know what you guys think of it.​
